map.name: Quarry Cadence
map.subtitle: Curb, double curb, elevated catch, then a wide explosive halo; each speed regime has its own reset.

pointMassCheck.limitations: No bike size, suspension, wheel collision, motor or air control.

physics.catchDesign: Velocity-envelope catch, Bezier compression, full flat recovery

physics.exitDirection: loop exit travels toward fallback; test reorientation before next obstacle

design.intent: Alternate deliberate low-speed ledges with a faster optional loop so speed control becomes the central skill.
design.signature: Curb, double curb, elevated catch, then a wide explosive halo; each speed regime has its own reset.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Introduce one intentional ledge and a broad wheel-settling shelf.
Allow a clean approach before repeating the ledge skill.
Repeat the weight transfer twice, then checkpoint on the stable shelf.
Transition from careful ledges into forward momentum.
Combine forward drive and front-wheel clearance over a visible elevated catch.
Use the plateau to reveal the loop and normalize its entry.
Offer a wide optional inversion; two branch-only boosts support its larger radius.
Provide a clear ground recovery after loop exit.
Finish with a familiar rollable shape after the speed contrast.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
